entries.wording: Equipment On-Board Seaboard Viking V. 22 Full.
entries.note: A full container on board a vessel, named with its voyage. The map reads every vessel and voyage alike.

entries.wording: Equipment At Port Of Miami Moving Export Full.
entries.note: A full container at a place on its way out as an export. The map reads every place alike, and an import alike.

entries.wording: Equipment On-Board Seaboard Galaxy V. 54 Empty.
entries.note: An empty container on board, carried without a shipment.

entries.wording: Equipment At Puerto Limon, Costa Rica Moving Import Empty.
entries.note: An empty container at a place. Without the moves before it, it does not tell a delivered shipment from a repositioned container.

entries.wording: Equipment At Puerto Cortes, Honduras Moving Import Empty.
entries.note: An empty container at a place.

entries.wording: Equipment At Port Of Miami Moving Import Empty.
entries.note: An empty container at a place named without its country.

entries.wording: Equipment At Garden City Terminal Moving Import Empty.
entries.note: An empty container at a terminal named without its city.

entries.wording: Equipment Dispatched To Customer Moving No Direction Empty.
entries.note: An empty container handed over to a customer.
